mechanism: Amoxicillin-clavulanate may enhance the nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity of amikacin, an aminoglycoside, particularly in patients with renal impairment or concurrent nephrotoxic exposures.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and audiometric function closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; adjust amikacin dosing based on renal function and therapeutic drug monitoring.
